title: As I Roved Out

nodes.title: As I Roved Out
nodes.body: A dorian. C natural is the one you just found. One line crosses the break on purpose: same holes, more air, then home. Words after you have heard the line. Singing stays ungraded.

source: Traditional song, Roud 3479, the Fermanagh line. Not a polka. Setting written for this pack: the body in the first octave, C natural in the line, one phrase across the break. Opening words of the traditional song.
